claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18650 3100mAh 20A as a 3100mAh preset with a 20A runtime rating.

Historical records identify a purple Efest IMR 18650 3100mAh variant as flat-top and unprotected; a separate retailer listing describes the same nominal size and 20A label but does not independently verify it.

The Efest IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Efest IMR 18650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2014-08-21 or earlier.
